‘Jailer 2’: After 40 years, Rajinikanth watches his blockbuster film with fans
 Superstar Rajinikanth watched his latest blockbuster, ‘Jailer 2’, with fans in an IMAX screens in Chennai
 Published - October 24, 2026 05:20 pm IST 
 The Hindu Bureau READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 Rajinikanth in ‘Jailer 2’.
 | Photo Credit: Sun Pictures/YouTube
 In a rare development, Tamil star Rajinikanth watched his latest blockbuster, Jailer 2 , with fans. Production house Sun Pictures posted on X (Formerly Twitter) that the superstar watched his film in a theatre with fans after four decades.
 ‘Jailer 2’ movie review: Rajinikanth’s flourishes elevate Nelson’s rousing herogasm “For the first time in 40 years, Superstar Rajinikanth joins fans to witness Jailer 2 on the big screen,” wrote Sun Pictures. Directed by Nelson, the Tamil movie hit the screens on October 15, 2026. With music composed by Anirudh Ravichander, the sequel to the 2023 hit has become a major blockbuster.
 Sun Pictures shared a video of Rajinikanth enjoying the movie on an IMAX screen with fans in Chennai. The veteran star is seen entering the theatre and greeting Anirudh. He later greets Nelson before heading home after the show.
 For the first time in 40 years, Superstar Rajinikanth joins fans to witness #Jailer2 on the big screen!😎🔥 #Jailer2 Industry Mega Blockbuster #Jailer2 Rampage in theatres worldwide @rajinikanth @Nelsondilpkumar @anirudhofficial @vidya_balan @iam_SJSuryah #MithunChakraborty #SurajVenjaramoodu @meramyakrishnan @iYogiBabu @mirnaaofficial @vijaykartikdop @Nirmalcuts @ChethanDsouza @AlwaysJani @KiranDrk @sunilreddy22 #PallaviSingh @valentino_suren @Alagiakoothan #SantoshRaju @kabilanchelliah @kuchirayar73 @RIAZtheboss @IMAX
— Sun Pictures (@sunpictures) October 24, 2026 Jailer 2 stars a huge ensemble , with SJ Suryah, Vidya Balan, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Namo Narayana, Shivarajkumar , Mohanlal, and Hrithik Roshan essaying prominent roles. The movie recently crossed the ₹500-crore box-office mark.
 ALSO READ: ‘Jailer 2’: Why Moorthy Anna is our spirit animal 
 The Hindu review of the movie said, “ Jailer 2 ends with a hint at a possible third film. Whether the Jailer template could sustain one more film, we can’t say yet. After all, before the first Jailer film, audiences had written off Nelson as a one-trick pony.
 “But Jailer 2 , especially, is proof of a serious filmmaker at the helm, who is also, incidentally, the funniest. Spotting this talent and trusting him to direct such a massive project — not once but twice — is another move only Rajini can make. In thalaivar we believe.”
